summary_rationale: Monster Beverage Corporation (MNST) earns a decisive COMPOUNDER_PASS on price-blind fundamental quality. Over 98.1% of revenue ($8.29B FY2025; $9.58B TTM Q3 2026) derives from asset-light energy drinks and concentrates distributed through The Coca-Cola Company's global DSD bottling network, generating 55.8% gross margin, 29.2% operating margin, 22.07% ROIC, and $1.97B FY2025 free cash flow (103.4% net income conversion; CapEx at 1.6% of sales) on a debt-free balance sheet ($3.71B cash & short-term investments). KPI health is rated PASS_WITH_WATCH: core energy KPIs are firing strongly (+18.0% YoY Q3 2026 unit case volume, $8.30/case realized pricing, ~47% international mix), tempered by three watch items—36% YoY aluminum cost inflation, a ~95-day working capital cycle (elevated DSO/inventory), and ongoing operating losses/impairments ($192.5M FY24–FY25) in the 1.6%-revenue Alcohol Brands sidecar.
